messages:
Ana R.: AltairOps (AT-560) INV-2026-0167 now 47 days overdue. Outstanding $6,420, no partials. Sent dunning #2 this morning.

Ben C.: Any reason for hold? Product tickets?

Ana R.: No product issues. They reported a payroll timing problem and asked for a split into 3 payments over 45 days.

Maya G.: Policy: minimum 30% upfront. For small balances we sometimes accept 30/35/35. Approve 30/35/35 if they provide bank confirmation for the first tranche within 5 business days and sign the plan.

CollectionsBot: [auto] Dunning #2 sent to ap@altairops.io (2026-04-18T08:22:10Z). Delivered.

Ben C.: I'll draft agreement and cc legal. Also request a PO number and that they list INV-2026-0167 on the remittance.

Ana R.: Please mark invoice as "payment-plan-proposed" and disable auto-suspend until first payment clears. Schedule reminder check in 7 days.

Maya G.: Approved contingent on signature + confirmation. If not received by check-in, escalate to legal and schedule suspension 48 hours after escalation.
